//: Lineage: written by hand. What every Craft app shares, defined once as the default for every app in design/apps.json.
An app's overrides lay over this (objects merge; arrays and values replace), then {id}, {name}, {version} and {port} are filled in from the app.
Read by: the validate stage in design/mise.toml (stage 4), design/config-generate (stage 5) and design/app-check (stage 2).
